data.narrative:
Quandela is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Valerian Giesz, Pascale Senellart, and Niccolo Somaschi, backed by PROQCIMA. The quantum computing sector comprises a fragmented comp universe of 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Traditional peer-median valuation proves inapplicable here. The quantum computing subsector contains only 5 same-sector peers total, with zero matching Quandela's Series B stage, zero in adjacent funding rounds, and zero within comparable valuation tiers. This scarcity of narrow-stage comparables makes a median-based triangulation unreliable; using all-sector medians would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of quantum technology approaches and commercialization timelines across the peer set.

Without sufficient narrow-stage data to support peer-median methodology, a full triangulation across conventional VC methods cannot be completed with the available information. Valuation work on Quandela would require either: expansion of stage-adjacent or tier-adjacent comparable data; application of alternative methods such as discounted cash flow modeling (dependent on revenue and margin assumptions not provided here); or venture-stage cost-of-capital frameworks. The extreme early-stage concentration and technological heterogeneity of the quantum computing sector currently constrains market-based valuation anchors.
